name: Cuckold Awakening
source:
Embark on a provocative journey of self-discovery in "Cuckold Awakening." This adult dating visual novel series explores the exhilarating depths of a couple's college life, as they embrace a thrilling cuckold lifestyle.

Dive into a world of passion, desire, and ethical exploration through captivating visuals, gripping choices, and thought-provoking storytelling. Push boundaries, challenge societal norms, and indulge in the complexities of love and jealousy.

Unleash your desires and shape the narrative with your decisions. Get ready for an unforgettable awakening where pleasure and exploration intertwine. Welcome to "Cuckold Awakening" – where passion knows no bounds.

[From [url=https://inkandtease.itch.io/cuckold-awakening]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在《Cuckold Awakening》中，踏上一段大胆的自我探索之旅。这部成人恋爱视觉小说系列围绕一对情侣展开：他们接受了伴侣与他人发生关系的刺激生活方式，也让大学生活变得愈发令人心跳加速。

借助引人入胜的画面、扣人心弦的选择与发人深省的叙事，走进一个交织着激情、欲望与伦理探索的世界。突破界限，挑战社会规范，体会爱情与嫉妒的复杂纠葛。

释放欲望，用你的决定塑造故事。准备迎接一场快感与探索交织的难忘觉醒吧。欢迎来到《Cuckold Awakening》，这里的激情没有边界。
